annotations.title: Get the feeling words in a category

description: Returns every word in one category of the Surfacing feelings list, such as "Sadness", "Fear & Anxiety", "Contempt & Malice", or "Calm & Grounded". Relevant when someone wants a more precise word for a feeling.

category.description: Category name, for example "Overwhelmed" or "Relational Hurt".
